x: While this was down to team performance, one should not diminish the individual efforts of Garry McGurren who finished 7th overall individual in the Surrey League, 16th in Surrey Championship, 1st in Club Championship and 1st in the Points Scheme.

Not least is that of Garry McGurren, who as a first year boy was second in the club championship, first in the points scheme and lead the boys team to the highest overall position (7th) in the Herne Hill league.

The most significant team result was stealing a highly contested Surrey Championship title with a fine individual 4th from Garry McGurren, backed by Matthew Kinane (flying in from Switzerland hours before), Simon Beaumont and Glynn Tiernan.
